title: Report the suite outcome when all tests are registered dynamically
summary: Two dynamically registered successful leaves now made the enclosing suite succeed. An empty dynamic container still failed the suite with NoTestsDiscoveredException.

change.description: The suite engine counts dynamic tests at registration when deciding whether a suite discovered any tests. A Jupiter factory can produce successful child tests after the initial discovery plan has been counted.

notes: A container is registered dynamically too. Its node groups children, while the two finished leaves independently establish the count.
